title: Add compaction telemetry and debug metrics parity
objective: Add the metrics and debug evidence needed to diagnose compaction quality, retry loops, prompt-cache behavior, and post-compact token pressure.
implementation_scope: Log preCompactTokenCount, compaction call token usage, true post-compact token estimate, and autoCompactThreshold.
Record whether post-compact context is likely to retrigger auto-compact.
Log query chain/depth or Go-equivalent turn identifiers.
Log prompt-cache read/create/drop metrics where provider usage exposes them.
Log compact PTL retries, auto-compact consecutive failures, and cache-sharing fallback/success where implemented.
Add token category breakdown hooks if Go already has context analysis utilities; otherwise add a narrow debug-only breakdown.
out_of_scope: Do not add an external analytics dependency.
Do not make telemetry required for compaction success.
acceptance_criteria: Compaction success and failure logs contain enough data to diagnose repeated compaction loops.
Auto-compact success logs include original and compacted message counts plus usage when available.
Telemetry calls are safe when usage fields are nil or providers do not support cache metrics.
Tests or fakes verify metrics emission for success, PTL retry, and failure paths.
risks: Metrics can accidentally log file paths or user content; keep payload metadata-only.
Over-instrumentation can introduce cycles if logging packages import compact code.
dispatch_prompt: Add metadata-only compaction telemetry and debug logs to Go so post-compact token pressure, cache behavior, retries, and failures are diagnosable like TS.
